blocked: Dynamics-level LOD (decimating a scene while it simulates) is blocked on P1-2 rigid reduction: the Phase 0 dynamics has no attractive bond — pair stiffness feeds modal analysis only, never the integrator — so multi-splat bodies disintegrate and moment-preserving merges of them would diverge immediately. G5 therefore verifies merge invariants, the adaptive policy against real M5 telemetry, and (optionally) a rendering-side decimation smoke with no dynamics claim.

g5c_render_smoke.note: render-side smoke not run (remote off); stride decimation is rendering-only, no dynamics claim
